import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.cwd()
def write(n,d):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=json.dumps(d,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
queries=['"Distinguishing number and distinguishing index of natural and fractional powers of graphs" journal correction','"Alikhani" "Soltani" "Conjecture 2.17"','graph square automorphism true twins square roots cycles coalescence counterexample']
write('search/plan1.json',{'queries':queries,'call':1,'purpose':'Current publication correction and primary square-twin construction comparison','immutable':True})
b=json.loads((p/'search-budget.json').read_text());assert b['calls_used']==0 and b['queries_used']==0
b.update(calls_used=1,queries_used=3);write('search-budget.json',b)
print(queries)
